answer: Reputation decay on idle identities. Each agent holds a decaying trust score; new identities start near zero and accrue score only through sustained valid work, while the whole ledger sits on a shared knoll of audited history. A sybil must run many identities through slow, real task cycles before any gains, paying compute and time per identity. Below a threshold, actions shrink to a garden of low-privilege calls, and colluding clusters trigger a whisper flag from cross-checks. Cost: weeks of genuine labor per fake identity.
